snippet.title: Game Market Mayhem - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Game Market Mayhem releases October 9th! 🎉🥳 Wishlist now! ❤️
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5144470/Game_Market_Mayhem

Jump into this cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. 🤯

Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!
